text_en: As for me, in the first year of Darius the Mede, I stood up to support and strengthen him.
text_cn: 玛待人达理阿王元年，他前来坚固我，协助我。

text_en: “Now I will announce the truth to you. Three more kings shall arise in Persia. The fourth shall be far richer than all of them, and when he has become strong through his riches, he shall stir up all against the kingdom of Greece.
text_cn: 现在我要把真事告诉你：看，在波斯还要兴起三位君王，第四位要拥有大量的财富，远远超过以前所有的君王；他因财富而强盛，于是煽动万国对抗雅汪国。

text_en: Then a warrior king shall arise, who shall rule with great dominion and take action as he pleases.
text_cn: 以后要兴起一位英勇的君王，他独掌大权，统治一切，为所欲为。

text_en: And while still rising in power, his kingdom shall be broken and divided toward the four winds of heaven, but not to his posterity, nor according to the dominion with which he ruled; for his kingdom shall be uprooted and go to others besides these.
text_cn: 但当他极盛的时候，他的国必要瓦解，他的天下必要四分五裂，而不归于他的后裔；也没有相似他所有的统治权，他的国必要灭亡，归属不是他后裔的外人。

text_en: “Then the king of the south shall grow strong, but one of his officers shall grow stronger than he and shall rule a realm greater than his own realm.
text_cn: 南方的君王要强盛起来，但他的将领中，有一个比他更强的要获得政权；他王国的势力非常强大。

text_en: After some years they shall make an alliance, and the daughter of the king of the south shall come to the king of the north to ratify the agreement. But she shall not retain her power, and his offspring shall not endure. She shall be given up, she and her attendants and her child and the one who supported her. “In those times
text_cn: 几年以后，他们要缔结同盟，南方君王的公主要嫁给北方的君王，以求修好；但是她得不到势力，她和她所生的也不能久存；她和她的侍从，她的儿子以及辅助她的都要被杀害。到那时，

text_en: a branch from her roots shall rise up in his place. He shall come against the army and enter the fortress of the king of the north, and he shall take action against them and prevail.
text_cn: 必从她根上出生一个嫩枝，继承父位；他必兴师出征，进入北方君王的堡垒，将他们击败，获得胜利；

text_en: Even their gods, with their idols and with their precious vessels of silver and gold, he shall carry off to Egypt as spoils of war. For some years he shall refrain from attacking the king of the north;
text_cn: 并将他们的神像、铸像和金银宝器劫往埃及，从此数年之久与北方的君王对峙；

text_en: then the latter shall invade the realm of the king of the south, but will return to his own land.
text_cn: 但北方的君王终要侵入南方君王的国土，事后仍返回本国。

text_en: “His sons shall wage war and assemble a multitude of great forces, which shall advance like a flood and pass through, and again shall carry the war as far as his fortress.
text_cn: 他的儿子必要备战，招募强大的劲旅，亲自出征；冲过时，相似洪水泛滥；他必猛攻，直逼敌军的堡垒。

text_en: Moved with rage, the king of the south shall go out and do battle against the king of the north, who shall muster a great multitude, which shall, however, be defeated by his enemy.
text_cn: 南方的君王必然大怒，出师与北方的君王交战，北方的君王也必调集大军，但这支大军必被交在敌方手中。

text_en: When the multitude has been carried off, his heart shall be exalted, and he shall overthrow tens of thousands, but he shall not prevail.
text_cn: 这支大军被掳去以后，南方的君王便心高气傲，不过他虽击毙千万大军，仍不能强盛，

text_en: For the king of the north shall again raise a multitude, larger than the former, and after some years he shall advance with a great army and abundant supplies.
text_cn: 因为北方君王必再调集大军，比以前更为庞大，数年以后，再率领大军，带着大量的辎（zī）重，出征南下。

text_en: “In those times many shall rise against the king of the south. The lawless among your own people shall lift themselves up in order to fulfill the vision, but they shall fail.
text_cn: 那时，将有许多人起来攻击南方君王，你百姓中的匪徒也要起来，为应验异象，但他们终必失败。

text_en: Then the king of the north shall come and throw up siegeworks, and take a well-fortified city. And the forces of the south shall not stand, not even his picked troops, for there shall be no strength to resist.
text_cn: 北方的君王就前来，兴建壁垒，攻取坚城，南方的军队不能抵抗，连精锐的部队也无力抵御。

text_en: But he who comes against him shall take the actions he pleases, and no one shall withstand him. He shall take a position in the beautiful land, and all of it shall be in his power.
text_cn: 来攻南方君王的，必任意而行，没有人能抵抗；他还要立足在华丽之地，破坏之权也操在他手中。

text_en: He shall set his mind to come with the strength of his whole kingdom, and he shall bring terms of peace and perform them. In order to destroy the kingdom, he shall give him a woman in marriage; but it shall not succeed or be to his advantage.
text_cn: 他企图征服整个南国，遂与南方君王立约通婚，将自己的女儿嫁给他，好倾覆他的国，但是他的企图没有成功，也没有见效。

text_en: Afterward he shall turn to the coastlands, and shall capture many. But a commander shall put an end to his insolence; indeed, he shall turn his insolence back upon him.
text_cn: 此后，他要转向各岛屿，占据了许多岛屿；但有一个将官要阻止他的蛮横，使他的蛮横害了自己。

text_en: Then he shall turn back toward the fortresses of his own land, but he shall stumble and fall, and shall not be found.
text_cn: 他遂转身回到他国内的堡垒里，终于一蹶不振，从此消失不见。

text_en: “Then shall arise in his place one who shall send an official for the glory of the kingdom; but within a few days he shall be broken, though not in anger or in battle.
text_cn: 以后另有一人代他兴起，他要派横征暴敛的人遍行国内华丽之地，但他没有过几天，就丧了命，不是由于叛变，也不是由于作战。

text_en: In his place shall arise a contemptible person on whom royal majesty had not been conferred; he shall come in without warning and obtain the kingdom through intrigue.
text_cn: 这以后，将有一个下贱的人代他兴起；原来人没有将治国的权力授给他，他却乘人不备，以阴谋篡夺了王位。

text_en: Armies shall be utterly swept away and broken before him, and the prince of the covenant as well.
text_cn: 来进攻他的大军要被他完全击溃，同盟之君也被击败。

text_en: And after an alliance is made with him, he shall act deceitfully and become strong with a small party.
text_cn: 有人与他联合，他即施行骗术；他借助少数的人民，就渐渐强大起来，

text_en: Without warning he shall come into the richest parts of the province and do what none of his predecessors had ever done, lavishing plunder, spoil, and wealth on them. He shall devise plans against strongholds, but only for a time.
text_cn: 他又乘人不备，侵入省内肥沃之区，实行他祖先及他祖先的祖先所未行过的事，将战利品、掠夺物和财产分给自己的党羽；又策划阴谋进攻堡垒，但只到某一限期。

text_en: He shall stir up his power and determination against the king of the south with a great army, and the king of the south shall wage war with a much greater and stronger army. But he shall not succeed, for plots shall be devised against him
text_cn: 他要竭尽自己的精力，鼓起勇气，率领大军进攻南方君王；南方君王亦率领极强大的劲旅奋起迎战，但无法抵御，因为有人筹划阴谋陷害他；

text_en: by those who eat of the royal rations. They shall break him, his army shall be swept away, and many shall fall slain.
text_cn: 那些破坏他的，正是吃他饭的人；他的劲旅将溃不成军，伤亡的极多。

text_en: The two kings, their minds bent on evil, shall sit at one table and exchange lies. But it shall not succeed, for there remains an end at the time appointed.
text_cn: 两位君王都存心不良，同坐一桌，各说谎话，而毫无成就，因为必须到所定的时期，才有结局。

text_en: He shall return to his land with great wealth, but his heart shall be set against the holy covenant. He shall work his will, and return to his own land.
text_cn: 北方的君王却要带着大量的财物返回本国；他既存心与圣约作对，也必采取行动，然后才回国。

text_en: “At the time appointed he shall return and come into the south, but this time it shall not be as it was before.
text_cn: 到了预定的时期，他必再度南征，但是第二次却不如第一次，

text_en: For ships of Kittim shall come against him, and he shall lose heart and withdraw. He shall be enraged and take action against the holy covenant. He shall turn back and pay heed to those who forsake the holy covenant.
text_cn: 因为此次基廷的船必来攻击他，他只得惊慌而归。 他遂迁怒于圣约，任意妄为；回去以后，他必重用那些背弃圣约的人士。

text_en: Forces sent by him shall occupy and profane the temple and fortress. They shall abolish the regular burnt offering and set up the abomination that makes desolate.
text_cn: 那些迎合他意思的军队，也去亵渎圣所的堡垒，废除日常祭，在那里设立了那招致荒凉的可憎之物。

text_en: He shall seduce with intrigue those who violate the covenant; but the people who are loyal to their God shall stand firm and take action.
text_cn: 至于那些作恶违犯圣约的人士，他要用诈术使他们更加败坏，但那认识自己天主的人民必也更加坚强有力。

text_en: The wise among the people shall give understanding to many; for some days, however, they shall fall by sword and flame, and suffer captivity and plunder.
text_cn: 民间贤明之士必要训诲民众，但他们有很多日子要受刀剑、烈火、充军和劫掠的迫害。

text_en: When they fall victim, they shall receive a little help, and many shall join them insincerely.
text_cn: 在他们受迫害时，稍微得到一些援助，但是有许多人却怀着奸诈的心与他们联合。

text_en: Some of the wise shall fall, so that they may be refined, purified, and cleansed, until the time of the end, for there is still an interval until the time appointed.
text_cn: 有些贤明之士要受迫害，是为锻炼、洗涤和洁净他们，直到时期结束，因为预定的时期尚未来到。

text_en: “The king shall act as he pleases. He shall exalt himself and consider himself greater than any god, and shall speak horrendous things against the God of gods. He shall prosper until the period of wrath is completed, for what is determined shall be done.
text_cn: 这位君王要任意妄为，妄自尊大，高举自己在众神之上，要发出怪谬的言论，反抗万神之神，他暂时行事顺利，直到天主的义怒泄尽，因为天主决定的事必要应验。

text_en: He shall pay no respect to the gods of his ancestors, or to the one beloved by women; he shall pay no respect to any other god, for he shall consider himself greater than all.
text_cn: 他不尊重自己祖先的神，也不尊重妇女们所爱的神，他不尊重任何神明，因为他将自己高举在一切以上；

text_en: He shall honor the god of fortresses instead of these; a god whom his ancestors did not know he shall honor with gold and silver, with precious stones and costly gifts.
text_cn: 却去敬拜堡垒之神，以金银、宝石和珍品恭奉他祖先所不认识的神。

text_en: He shall deal with the strongest fortresses by the help of a foreign god. Those who acknowledge him he shall make more wealthy, and shall appoint them as rulers over many, and shall distribute the land for a price.
text_cn: 他要凭借外神的助佑，攻击坚固的堡垒；凡附和他的，他必增加他们的光荣，使他们治理民众，分封土地，作为赏报。

text_en: “At the time of the end the king of the south shall attack him. But the king of the north shall rush upon him like a whirlwind, with chariots and horsemen, and with many ships. He shall advance against countries and pass through like a flood.
text_cn: 到末期，南方的君王将要与他交战；北方的君王也要率领战车、骑兵和许多战舰，像旋风般向他还击，侵入他的国土；所经之地，有如洪水破堤。

text_en: He shall come into the beautiful land, and tens of thousands shall fall victim, but Edom and Moab and the main part of the Ammonites shall escape from his power.
text_cn: 他要侵入华丽之地，千万人要丧亡，但是厄东、摩阿布和大部分阿孟子民，却要逃脱他的手。

text_en: He shall stretch out his hand against the countries, and the land of Egypt shall not escape.
text_cn: 他又要伸手攻击各国，埃及地亦不能幸免；

text_en: He shall become ruler of the treasures of gold and of silver, and all the riches of Egypt; and the Libyans and the Ethiopians shall follow in his train.
text_cn: 他要占有金银府库和埃及的一切宝物。利比亚和雇士人也要来与他联合。

text_en: But reports from the east and the north shall alarm him, and he shall go out with great fury to bring ruin and complete destruction to many.
text_cn: 但是来自东方和北方的消息要使他震惊；他遂怀着盛怒去讨伐，要将许多人杀尽灭绝。

text_en: He shall pitch his palatial tents between the sea and the beautiful holy mountain. Yet he shall come to his end, with no one to help him.
text_cn: 他要在海洋和美丽圣山之间，支搭他堂皇的帐幕，但此时已到了他的末日，已没有任何人能援助他。
